findings.title: Monitor config context returns unmodified config, discarding schedule_type display
findings.body: get_monitor_environment_context copies monitor.config into `config` and replaces `schedule_type` with the human-readable display value, but the returned context uses `monitor_environment.monitor.config` instead of the modified `config`. As a result the emitted event context contains the raw config (and raw schedule_type) and the intended display transformation never happens.

findings.title: Incident can be created before failure_issue_threshold failures when history is short
findings.body: When failure_issue_threshold > 1, the code slices the last `failure_issue_threshold` check-ins and only checks whether any of them is OK. It never verifies that `len(previous_checkins) >= failure_issue_threshold`. For a monitor environment with fewer check-ins than the threshold and no OK check-in (for example, a new monitor whose first check-ins fail), the function proceeds to set MonitorStatus.ERROR and create a MonitorIncident, effectively treating the threshold as 1. This can create incidents earlier than configured.
